concerns.text: FR-009 requires a phylogenetic distance matrix for the KNN baseline. Tasks T016a (synthetic matrix), T016b (real matrix), and T016c (tree fetch) are marked as incomplete (unchecked). Without these, the baseline model (FR-009) and the KNN training task (T021) cannot execute, blocking US2.

FR-002 requires phylogenetic MICE for missing traits. Tasks T014a (logic) and T014b (implementation) are unchecked. While T014a mentions a fallback to Median Substitution, the primary requirement (Phylogenetic MICE) is not implemented, leaving FR-002 unfulfilled.

FR-009 requires training a KNN baseline. Task T021 implements this but depends on the phylogenetic matrix from T016a/b/c. Since T016a/b/c are incomplete, T021 is effectively blocked and FR-009 is not covered by a runnable task.

SC-005 requires validating top features against 15 independent ABA genes. Task T029 implements the report logic but is unchecked. Task T028 (Permutation Importance) is also unchecked. Without these, the validation logic for SC-005 is missing.

Plan 'Single Source of Truth' requires metrics in `data/logs/metrics.json`. Task T030 ensures this but is unchecked. No other task explicitly guarantees the creation of this specific artifact with the required keys.

Review concerns regarding statistical rigor (power analysis) and data lineage are addressed in T039 and T040, but both are unchecked. These are critical for the 'Methodological Rigor' section of the plan and the validity of the results.

The quickstart/run-book requires `code/run_pipeline.py` as the entry point. Task T041 creates this script but is unchecked. Without it, the pipeline cannot be executed as a single command, violating the 'Execution' requirement of the plan.

Task T012 is marked as 'Foundational' but is unchecked. It generates the synthetic genomic data required for US1. If this is intended to be a fallback, it must be explicitly linked to the 'Validation Mode' logic in T006, which it is, but the task itself remains incomplete.

Tasks T036 (retry logic) and T037 (exclusion logging) are unchecked. While T011a/b cover download logic, these specific enhancements for HTTP errors and auditability are distinct tasks that remain unimplemented.
